import functools
import subprocess


def helper(f, argv):
    f(argv)


sink = subprocess.run
p = functools.partial(helper, sink, ["pacman", "-S", "r22-cxpcall"])
sink = print
p()

Only a creation-time freeze of both the literal and the callable binding is exact. Limits: this is exact static semantics for this text, not current-code behavior.
